subject: delta(client): WF keep a failed suspension write beside the re-hold or host stop refusal's own cause
note: When the suspension write after a re-hold or host stop failed, the service and the protocol set the write's error as the refusal's cause only when it had none, so a stop_check_failed refusal, which carries the stop check's error, or a profile_not_admitted refusal with a cause, dropped the write failure. Both writers now leave the refusal's cause as it was and keep the write's error as details.suspensionWriteError. The README says so, and a test fails the suspension write while a throwing stop check refuses a request mid-flight.
